instruction: The default font size for composing emails is too small for me to read comfortably. Please change the default HTML message font size to 18 pixels so that my emails are more readable.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default HTML message font size (msgcompose.font_size) to 18 pixels. Evaluator checks if the preference is set to '18'. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.
